name: adk-docs
desc: An open-source, code-first toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control.

name: Eta
desc: 在 ColorOS 与 HyperOS 上实现系统级 Android AI Agent。通过类似豆包手机的 GUI Agent 实现跨应用操作，同时提供结构化设备工具，让模型无需依赖 GUI 即可直达系统能力。凭借支持 Root Shell 与 Linux 环境的终端能力，进一步覆盖 Android 世界中更广泛的任务，并解锁 Gemini 与一圈即搜

name: MemOS
desc: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings

name: open-multi-agent
desc: TypeScript AI agent orchestration framework with dynamic workflows. Describe the goal, not the graph: a coordinator plans the task DAG at runtime and runs it on any LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or local models).

name: cindy
desc: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。

name: Zoo-Code
desc: Zoo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.

name: DashClaw
desc: 🛡️The governance runtime for AI agents. Intercept actions, enforce guard policies, require approvals, and produce audit-ready decision trails.

name: autonoma
desc: Open-source testing platform where AI agents navigate your app end-to-end and catch regressions on every PR. No test code required.

name: loopx
desc: Lightweight loop engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams. Agent-loop agnostic across Codex, Claude Code, and other coding agents, with durable goals, quota-aware auto-wake, executable todos, evidence logs, and verifiable handoffs.

name: conductor
desc: Conductor is an event driven agentic workflow engine providing durable and highly resilient execution engine for applications and AI Agents
